# The agency owner who fired himself from onboarding

## Problem

Marcus ran a small content agency and he was the bottleneck on everything.
Nothing shipped unless he touched it. Onboarding a new client ate five hours of
his week, every time, because the whole process lived in his head.

## Action

We spent six weeks pulling the onboarding out of his head and into a documented
system. Every step written down, an owner assigned, a checklist his coordinator
could run without him.

## Outcome

He handed it to his coordinator and stopped being the bottleneck. His own
onboarding time dropped from five hours to one.

> [!tip] Why this story lands
> The phrase "he fired himself from his own process" reframes delegation as
> documentation, not loss of control.
